geometry.visibleText: HOME DASHBOARD - OVERHAUL Dashboard sections are hidden Turn on at least one Home screen section to show study information here. Open Home screen settings

STUDY CALENDAR Your study at a glance Month Year ‹ Today › ⚙ Some dashboard data is unavailable. Unavailable: buried-card counts, due forecast, study history, remaining-card counts, Today metrics. Refresh the Deck Browser; if this persists, restart Anki. 2026 M T W T F S S Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec 3 4 Less More completed Review cards due Event Select a date for details TODAY Total Cards Studied — New Cards Studied — Time studied — Pace — ETA — TODAY’S PROGRESS Percent Complete — New remaining — Learning remaining — Reviews remaining — Total remaining — BURIED CARDS New — Learning — Reviews — CONSISTENCY Avg cards / day — Active days — Longest streak — Current streak — BIBLE VERSE How precious is your unfailing love, O God! All humanity finds shelter in the shadow of your wings. Psalm 36:7 (NLT)

HOME DASHBOARD - OVERHAUL Ready to replace duplicate home-screen add-ons The unified dashboard is paused while these legacy add-ons are enabled: Review Heatmap. Open settings to review the migrated layout, then disable the legacy add-ons and restart Anki. Open dashboard settings

Home Dashboard - Overhaul 1.5.3 · Anki Desktop 26.8 · configuration schema 3 · AGPL-3.0-or-later.
Version 1.5.3 is packaged for Anki Desktop 26.8. The Caleb M. settings menu route, dashboard bridge commands, and schema-3 storage remain compatible.
Migration completed on 2026-08-15T16:59:22-05:00 with no recorded warnings.

Study analytics, deck exclusions, local events, the verse library, and rotation state remain on this device in Anki’s add-on data. Ordinary previews reuse a cached snapshot, disable Deck Browser-only actions, and do not query the collection or contact an external calendar service.

Disable Home Dashboard - Overhaul and re-enable the original add-ons. Migration never edits, moves, or deletes their configuration. Keep a copy of exported verses before replacing a heavily edited library.
Customize the verse card separately from its library. Selecting a library item previews that exact verse without changing daily or manual rotation state.
Applies only to verse body and reference text.
The dashboard remains responsive at larger values.
Used only when theme-aware color is turned off.
Uses the preset’s readable text token and disables the custom color control.
Daily uses the civil date; refresh can change each render; manual preserves the current stored choice.
The library is staged with the rest of settings. Imports trim empty entries, skip exact duplicates, and stop at 500 verses.
Choose manual rotation to set a specific current verse.
Manage local dashboard events. Past events move to Archived automatically; archive and restore are reversible.
All event changes remain staged until you choose Save changes.
Select an event to edit, archive, restore, or delete it.
Choose what appears on the Deck Browser. Disabled dependencies preserve your stored preference and become available again when their requirement is restored.
Shows completed reviews, due forecasts, and date details in Month or Year view.
Adds your local event markers to the calendar. Requires Study calendar.
Requires Study calendar. Your event preference remains saved while unavailable.
Total answers, new cards studied, time studied, pace, and the optional ETA.
Completed percentage and the live actionable new, learning, and review queues.
Counts buried new, learning, and review cards without changing them.
Average active-day reviews, active-day percentage, and streaks.
Shows the selected verse card after the study dashboard.
Changes presentation only; the underlying study history is unchanged.
Uses the live actionable queue and current pace. Requires Today.
Requires Today. Your ETA preference remains saved while unavailable.
Counts a card as newly studied when its first qualifying answer follows a manual reschedule.
Choose the dashboard’s visual system, then tune its spacing and scale. The editor and preview follow these staged choices immediately.
Coordinated surfaces, text, borders, focus, and status colors.
Sapphire Glass
Follow Anki responds to the application theme without rewriting your preference.
Controls how solid the dashboard cards appear.
Compact fits more information; Spacious adds breathing room.
Adjusts dashboard typography independently of Anki’s interface scale.
Control the calendar display and which collection history contributes to it. Collection-backed changes are staged now and recalculated only after Save.
Month is conventional; Year emphasizes long-term consistency.
Applied consistently to Month and Year layouts.
Choose All history or a rolling day limit. A History start date can narrow it further.
Adds due-card markers without combining them with completed-review intensity.
Available only while Show due forecast is enabled.
Study counts and due forecasts follow the configured rollover, not calendar midnight. Events continue to use their civil-calendar date.
When both controls are set, the later of this date and the rolling day limit wins.
Filters manual reschedule and forget log entries.
Filters logs whose cards no longer exist.
A checked parent excludes its descendants during collection analytics; full deck paths are retained.
